title: UPPER and LOWER change the case of letters only
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "u", UPPER ( "DAX is so cool!" ), "l", LOWER ( "DAX is so cool!" ) )

source.quote: UPPER and LOWER convert their only argument in uppercase or lowercase, respectively
source.supports: the example shows UPPER = DAX IS SO COOL! and LOWER = dax is so cool!
